book.name: Luka
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Luka gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Jiso bu yi kwe le
Juu chi yuuŋ gɛ̀ fe, bvuyuu juu chì fwe yi kimaa le. Bikɛse baa bu bo yaŋsɛ lo an'yule, bo jo mɛɛ mà gwee wuŋ mà bo gɛ̀ seesɛ bo mo bo gɛɛne bɛ mo fɛ jɛŋ.
Lɛ bo doo bo gɛɛŋ bo bu fo, bo yɛŋ ba biŋsɛ wa tɛdɛ chì ba gɛ̀ baŋɛ jwe wu jɛŋ yɛɛ yu.
Lɛ bo lee bo gɛɛŋ a jɛŋ bo gɛ yɛŋ gvunɛ chi Tada Jiso le gɛ.
Bo gɛ̀ lɛɛŋ fo bo ŋgɛsɛ lo. Fi kooshɛ lɛ bilɛŋsɛ bafɛɛ gɛ̀ bee bo ja bo to bo lɛɛŋ mbebe yiboo le, bo noŋ njú yì baaŋ yi lale.
Bikɛse baa gɛ̀ faaŋ baaŋ, bo mo bo tuŋ bikwɛɛ fɛkuu. Bilɛŋsɛ baa biih bo le lɛ, “Le nje la wù bɛŋ goone muh wù baaŋ yu antɛnɛɛ a baŋkfu?
Gɛ wu nyu fɛnɛ gɛ, wu le wu bu wa yi kwe le. Bɛŋ kwâjɛ fiɛɛ fì wu gɛ̀ jɛmɛ bɛŋ le sege bena bo gɛ̀ bee Galalee.
Wu gɛ̀ bee wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: ‘Muh wù jee che le Mwamuh lé ba kɛ̂me ki ba nyâ wu chiaaŋ yi bamii ba befe le, ba ge ba ta wu yi kintaaŋ le, doo bu aju atade, wu bu yi kwe le.’”

content: Bo mo bo kwajɛ fiɛɛ fì Jiso gɛ̀ jɛmɛ bo le.
Bo gɛ̀ ja fɛ jɛŋ, bo kaasɛ bo tu jiŋ bo gɛɛŋ bo sɛɛŋ mwɛɛ munɛ munchii booŋ be ba ŋgoo ba yuufe ncho wu mumwaa le mo bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ bii wu le.
Bikɛse ba gɛ̀ sɛŋe fiɛɛ fì gɛ̀ kooshɛ fiyu booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso le gɛ̀ bee Mɛɛle Madaleŋ, Joana mo Mɛɛle wu bwe Jɛm bɛ bikɛse bamu.
Bo yu njɛmɛ wuyu gɛh njɛ le njɛmɛ wu achiji, bo gɛ bɛɛŋ gɛ.
Geenɛ, Bita ja we, wu legɛ wu gɛɛŋ wu bu fɛ jɛŋ, wu ŋgvuumɛ wu bijɛ a jɛŋ wu yɛŋ gɛh nyu njú yì ba gɛ̀ giŋsɛ Jiso yu le. Wu mo wu ja wu tuu jiŋ fɛ yeh le wù kɛme kiŋgha yi fiɛɛ fì kooshi le.
Bamii bamu yɛŋ Jiso le je yi Imayu le
Fi gɛ̀ kooshɛ gɛh abvu lɛ, bamii bamu bafɛɛ bo gɛ̀ bii Jiso le bo gɛ̀ ja Yɛlusalɛm bo gɛɛne ntɛ wù ba tɛŋe lɛ Imayu le, gɛ̀ bee njɛ bama bvusooshwi ki wo gɛ̂ɛŋ wo bu yo.
Bo tu bo gɛɛne bo jɛme lɛbolɛbo kune mwɛɛ mù gɛ̀ kooshɛ munchii.
No bo gɛ̀ jiɛnyi bo jɛme bo tuu fo noo, Jiso gɛ̀ bee wu kɛŋsɛ wu to mbebe yiboo le wu tu wu jiɛnyi bɛ bo.
Fiɛɛ fimi ge lɛ keefɛ bo kɛ̂ɛ muh wuyu gɛ.
Jiso mo wu ja wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Le fiɛɛ fì la fì bɛŋ jiɛnyi bɛŋ jɛme kune fi?”

content: No wu biide noo, bo lɛɛmɛ bɛ yii yi manshi maboo le.
Muh lɛ bo le wu jee che gɛ̀ bee lɛ Kleofa wu biih wu le lɛ, “Mɛ gɛh wo maa wu le ntolo Yɛlusalɛm wù baaŋ kɛɛ gɛ mwɛɛ mu chi kooshɛ yo aju kane le gɛ?”
Wu biih lɛ,

Bo chvuu lɛ, “Mwɛɛ mù chi kooshɛ bɛ Jiso wu Nasalɛ. Muh wunɛ chi bee muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo. Mwɛɛ mù wu chi gee mo mù wu chi jɛme chi bee mù ghage. Chi bee muh wù kuge baaŋ a Nyo fwe bɛ bamii bachii.
Bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba sage woŋ wese chi bo nya wu lɛ ba yuuyɛ. Bo chi bo mo bo ta wu yi kintaaŋ le.
Bee chi be gɛɛ wa bvufee yi ye ye le, lɛ le wu wù lé wu gê wu sûuŋ bamii ba Ishwala chiaaŋ yi ŋgɛ le. Geenɛ le ge wa aju atade no mwɛɛ muyu chi kooshɛ.
Fimi nyu bikɛse bamu ŋgoo yese le, bo be bo jɛmɛ fi fuuŋsɛ lo bee, lɛ bo le bo bu bo gɛɛŋ fɛ jɛŋ ataana,
bo baaŋ yɛŋ gɛ gvunɛ che le gɛ. Bo doo bo kaase bo tuu jiŋ, bo sɛɛŋ lɛ bo bee bo yɛŋ banchɛndaa ba Nyo le njɛ bo yɛŋ a kifilɛ le, bo jɛmɛ bo le lɛ Jiso le yu.
Bamii bamu ŋgoo yese le, le bo gɛɛŋ fɛ jɛŋ fɛ yu bo yɛŋ yi le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no bikɛse bayu be jɛmɛ, geenɛ, bo baaŋ yɛŋ gɛ Jiso le gɛ.”
Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “O oo, biyuŋ binɛ, muntele mwɛna jiɛɛ baaŋ ki bɛŋ bɛ̂ɛŋ mwɛɛ mù bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo gɛ̀ jɛme.
Gɛ bɛŋ kee lɛ Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka gɛ̀ kɛme ki wu yɛ̂ŋ baŋgɛ fɛ wu lee yi bvukugɛ bwe le gɛ?”

content: Jiso mo wu kɛ wu naji bo mwɛɛ munchii mù ba gɛ̀ saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le kune wu kɛge yi mù Musɛ gɛ̀ saŋ le, gɛɛŋ bu tɛ yi mu bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo le.
No bo gɛ̀ too wa bo bude mbebe ntɛ wu bo gɛ̀ gɛɛne yo le, Jiso ja wu tu wù gee njɛ wu fede lo.
Bo lɛgɛ wu wesee bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Bee gɛ̂ɛŋ be chê, kife le ki gɛɛŋ ka baaŋ, akfuuŋ kɛ wa a jimɛ.” Noo, wu bɛɛŋ ki wu gɛ̂ɛŋ wu che bɛ bo.
Bo gɛɛŋ, bo doo bo jii mwɛɛ, wu jo chefe yi blɛd, wu nya kiyone Nyo le, wu bwɛɛyɛ wu nya bo le.
Kimimia noo, ajii aboo yuu, bo mo bo kɛɛ wu. Wu jaŋɛ wu lɛsɛ a bo jii.
Bo shɛɛ bo tu bo maŋe lɛbolɛbo lɛ, “Gɛ muntele mwesa besa wo be yuufe sege wu be jɛme besa wo le a je, wu naji mwɛɛ mu a Ŋwa wu Nyo le gɛ?”

Bo mo bo ja kimimia kinfu kɛɛ le juu chi yu bo mo bo tuu jiŋ Yɛlusalɛm. Bo doo bo gɛɛŋ, bo yɛŋ booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo ba yuufe ncho wu mumwaa le bo banyɛ ye kijusɛ ki mumwaa bɛ bamii bamu bo gɛ̀ kɛ bo bii wu le.
Bo jɛme lɛ, “Nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ, Tada wese le wu bu yi kwe le. Wu bee wu jagɛ wu bunɛ a Samoŋ jii.”
Bo mo bo sɛɛŋ tɛ bo fiɛɛ fì be kooshɛ bɛ bo a je, bo mo bo najɛ tɛ no bo be kɛlɛ lɛ le wu, sege wu be bwɛɛyɛ blɛd.
Jiso bunɛ a booŋ be ba ŋgoo ntɛnɛɛ
Gɛh no bo gɛ̀ baaŋ bo jɛme noo, Jiso jagɛ wu bunɛ a bo antɛnɛɛ wu mo wu yɛsɛ bo le lɛ,
Njaŋ koo bo, bo tu bo faane, bo kwaji lɛ bo le bo yɛŋ nyu kiyi kimi le.
Wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ faane la? Ge la fɛ bɛŋ maŋɛ mɛ?
Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ chiaaŋ yaŋ bɛ bikaa biaŋ, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ kɛɛ lɛ le mɛ kibɛɛ. Bɛŋ monyɛ ye yaŋ bɛŋ mo bɛŋ kɛɛ, nje gɛ kiyi to ki kɛme nyaŋ yi ye bɛ biŋkufɛ no bɛŋ yɛde ŋkɛme nɛ gɛ.”

content: No wu jɛme noo, wu mo wu dunyɛ chiaaŋ ye bɛ bikaa bie bo le.
Bo bijɛ Jiso, njoŋ yuuyɛ lo bo, bo mo bo ŋgɛsɛ lo. Fi ya bo ki bo bɛɛŋ lɛ le wu. Wu ja wu biih bo le lɛ,
Bo jo kinchiŋ ki biɛŋ yi ba yoŋ wa, bo nya wu le.
Wu fi wu ji a bo jii.
Wu mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Mwɛɛ munɛ mu bɛŋ yɛŋ abɛŋ le mu mù ŋgɛ̀ njɛme bɛŋ le kune mu mbaaŋ besabɛŋ. Ŋgɛ̀ ndu lɛ mwɛɛ munchii mù ba gɛ̀ saŋ kune mɛ a Ŋwa wu Musɛ le, bɛ a Baŋwa ba bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo le mo a Ŋwa wu Mbɛɛŋsɛ le, mu kɛme ki mu tô mu kojɛ.”

content: Wu mo wu gwenyɛ bvufee bvuboo, bo kɛɛ mwɛɛ mu le a Ŋwa wu Nyo le.
Wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Ba le ba saŋ lɛ Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka kɛme ki wu yɛ̂ŋ ŋgɛ wu kwe, doo ge aju atade, wu bu yi kwe le.
Fi mo fi nyu tɛ lɛ bo lé bo kɛ̂ Yɛlusalɛm, bo fêeji bituŋ le bichii kune jee che lɛ bamii bachii kusɛ muntele muboo, fɛ Nyo lɛɛshɛ bimbefɛ biboo.
Lé ge fêeji bɛŋ banɛ ba yɛŋ mwɛɛ munɛ le.
Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, nlé ŋgê nchîiŋsɛ nnya yì Chii gɛ̀ ka wa bɛŋ yu. Noo, bɛŋ mɛ gɛh alaantɛŋ yanɛ bɛŋ chîɛɛne bvuŋga bvù lé bvu gê bvu shîi fɛwe bvu tô fɛ bɛŋ le.”

content: Jiso bɛɛŋ we
Wu jo bo wu bu bɛ bo a kinlaantɛŋ kiyu le, bɛ bo gɛɛŋ bo bu mbebe ntɛ wù Bɛtani le, wu chiaasɛ chiaaŋ ye we, wu noŋ kimbonɛ ye yiboo le.
Gɛ no wu gɛ̀ baaŋ wu nooŋ kimbonɛ ye yiboo le noo, wu mo wu ja wu tu wu bɛɛne we, wu mo wu bɛɛŋ wu lɛsɛ.
Bo nya mbɛɛŋsɛ wù baaŋ wu le, bo mo bo ja fo bo tuu jiŋ Yɛlusalɛm bɛ kinlaŋye fɛ muntele muboo le.
Bo gɛɛŋ bo mo bo shee yeh yi kintanyɛ le, bo bɛɛŋse Nyo bo yuuse wu segechii.

footnotes.text: Ma wu mumwaaŋ le bataŋ ba jiɛnyɛ lɛ nchvuge bɛ gii bvusooshwi (1,700).
